## Description

Preprocessing of Copenhagen sewage metagenomic data: cleaning abundance tables, handling replicates, filtering rare taxa, retrieving taxonomy, and building an mgnet object.

## Libraries

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(taxizedb)
library(furrr)
library(data.table)
```

## Abun

```{r, message=FALSE}
abun  <- fread("raw/genomic_species_abundance.csv.gz") %>%
  column_to_rownames("V1")

cleaned_taxa <- colnames(abun) %>%
  gsub("\\[|\\]", "", .) %>%          
  trimws() %>%
  setNames(colnames(abun)) %>%
  enframe(name = "taxa_id", value = "taxa_clean")

abun <- abun %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "sample_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "taxa_id", values_to = "abun") %>%
  left_join(cleaned_taxa, by = "taxa_id") %>%
  group_by(sample_id, taxa_clean) %>%
  summarise(abun = sum(abun), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "taxa_clean", values_from = "abun") %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")

rm(cleaned_taxa)
```

## Meta

```{r, message=FALSE}
meta <- read_csv("raw/meta_location.csv") %>%
  rename(specimen = sample_id) %>%
  column_to_rownames("complete_name")
```

```{r}
temperature <- read.csv("raw/temperatures.csv")

temperature <- temperature %>%
  select(NAME, DATE, TMIN, TMAX) %>%
  filter(str_detect(NAME, "KOEBENHAVN")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TMIN) | !is.na(TMAX)) %>%
  mutate(DATE = as.Date(DATE, "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  filter(DATE >= "2019-01-01", DATE <= "2020-10-01") %>%
  mutate(TMEAN = .5*(TMIN + TMAX)) %>%
  group_by(DATE) %>%
  summarise(TMEAN = mean(TMEAN))
```


## Remove replicates and select Copenaghen samples

```{r}
sample_norep_cph <- abun %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "sample_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "taxa_id", values_to = "abun") %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(sample_sum = sum(abun), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(as_tibble(meta, rownames = "sample_id"), by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(city == "Copenhagen") %>%
  group_by(specimen) %>%
  slice_max(sample_sum) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(sample_id)
```

```{r}
abun <- abun[sample_norep_cph, ]
meta <- meta[sample_norep_cph, ]
rm(sample_norep_cph)
```

```{r}
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(plant = str_remove_all(plant, "Rensningsanlaeg "),
         plant = factor(plant,
                        levels = c("Avedoere", "Damhusaaen", "Lynetten")))
```


## Remove to rare taxa

```{r, message=FALSE}
abun <- abun[, colSums(abun) >= 100]
```

## Retrive taxonomy

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Original feature names
# One row per column of abun
# -----------------------------
name_tbl <- tibble(name = colnames(abun))

# -----------------------------
# Name -> tax_id mapping
# -----------------------------
ncbi_id_raw <- name2taxid(colnames(abun), out_type = "summary")

# If the summary output contains repeated identical pairs, remove exact duplicates only
ncbi_id_raw <- ncbi_id_raw %>%
  distinct(name, id)

# IMPORTANT:
# We now want one row per original name in abun.
# If a name has multiple possible tax_ids, we still need one row.
# The simplest choice is to keep the first available match for that name.
# This does NOT affect the case "many names -> same tax_id", which remains intact.
name2id_tbl <- name_tbl %>%
  left_join(
    ncbi_id_raw %>%
      group_by(name) %>%
      slice(1) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      transmute(name, tax_id = as.character(id)),
    by = "name"
  )

# -----------------------------
# Classification function
# -----------------------------
wanted_ranks <- c("kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species")

extract_ranks <- function(tax_id) {
  cl <- tryCatch(
    classification(tax_id, db = "ncbi"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  out <- setNames(as.list(rep(NA_character_, length(wanted_ranks))), wanted_ranks)

  if (!is.null(cl) && length(cl) > 0 && !is.null(cl[[1]])) {
    cl <- cl[[1]]

    for (r in wanted_ranks) {
      hit <- cl$name[cl$rank == r]
      out[[r]] <- if (length(hit) > 0) hit[1] else NA_character_
    }
  }

  tibble(
    tax_id = as.character(tax_id),
    kingdom = out$kingdom,
    phylum  = out$phylum,
    class   = out$class,
    order   = out$order,
    family  = out$family,
    genus   = out$genus,
    species = out$species
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Parallel classification only on unique tax_ids
# -----------------------------
tax_ids <- name2id_tbl$tax_id %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

plan(multisession, workers = 6)

taxonomy_lookup <- future_map_dfr(
  tax_ids,
  extract_ranks,
  .progress = TRUE
)

plan(sequential)

# -----------------------------
# Final taxonomy table
# Same number of rows as ncol(abun)
# Same order as colnames(abun)
# -----------------------------
taxonomy_df <- name2id_tbl %>%
  left_join(taxonomy_lookup, by = "tax_id") %>%
  select(tax_id, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(taxonomy_df) <- colnames(abun)
```

```{r}
rm(name_tbl, name2id_tbl, ncbi_id_raw, taxonomy_lookup, tax_ids, wanted_ranks, extract_ranks)
```

```{r}
all(rownames(abun) == rownames(meta))
all(colnames(abun) == rownames(taxonomy_df))
```

## Build mgnet object

```{r}
library(mgnet)
sewage_cph <- mgnet(abun = as.matrix(abun), meta = meta, taxa = taxonomy_df)
```

## Save rds formats

```{r}
saveRDS(abun, "processed/abun.rds")
saveRDS(meta, "processed/meta.rds")
saveRDS(taxonomy_df, "processed/taxa.rds")
saveRDS(sewage_cph, "processed/sewage_cph_mgnet.rds")
```
